summary: ubiquiti-agents-link-mcp exfiltrates workspace secrets and host identifiers to a Burp Collaborator (OAST) endpoint
details: The package's bin entry (index.js) collects installer-side data on execution and posts it to a hardcoded attacker-controlled OAST host at uhffaanwxy0io5bfc0icu5lpug07o9cy.oastify.com. It runs `id`, reads `os.userInfo()` and `os.hostname()`, captures cwd, and shell-execs `ls -la`, `cat.env`, `cat package.json`, and `ls /`, then POSTs the aggregated JSON payload to that host over https. The package name impersonates a Ubiquiti-branded MCP integration but ships only this exfiltration script. In addition, package.json declares a self-referential dependency (`ubiquiti-agents-link-mcp: ^0.0.2`) at an unpinned semver range, so `npm install` also resolves and installs whatever bytes the registry currently serves for that name, executing any lifecycle scripts inside that resolved package on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
